subject: Monthly KPI orbit: readiness check & action lanecard
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@novaapps.com>
Date: 2028-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Monthly KPI orbit: readiness check & action lanecard

Team — attaching the October KPI snapshot and a short lanecard of proposed actions. Quick summary of top signals from the dashboard (see oct_kpi_dashboard.png):

- Latency: 95th p90 spike last 48h -> from 220ms baseline to 380ms on large-chat routes.
- Cost: Monthly token spend +22% M/M; dedicated burst utilization up; unit costs rising on long-context workloads.
- Uptime: Minor control-plane incidents on 10/05 caused brief 5m blip; overall "99.94%" vs our 99.99% SLO.
- Usage: Active customer queries +18% M/M, sustained over week-long demo with NovaApps.

Immediate asks:
1) Markus: please drive the latency root cause and recommend kernel/scale changes — any quick mitigation we can flip this week?
2) Laura: cost actionables — can we cap burst or change auto-burst policy mid-month? Also please attach the cost breakdown.
3) Soojin: ops/rollouts — if we need to revert canaries or change routing policies, outline the rollback play.

Proposed 30-minute sync to align owners and commit actions: Tue 10/09 10:00 PT. If that works for Olivia from NovaApps, we can keep them on for visibility.

Attachments: oct_kpi_dashboard.png, cost_breakdown_q3.xlsx

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia@novaapps.com>
Date: 2028-10-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Monthly KPI orbit: readiness check & action lanecard

Thanks — quick diagnostics so the group has context. I looked at the call stacks and KV cache pressure during the spike window. Notes:

- Correlated increase with the 2028-09-29 model_variant roll (chat-large-1.2q). New kernels for grouped attention introduced higher mem copies for short sequences; that shows up as increased per-request latency under mixed-length traffic.
- Canary nodes show ~35ms degradation vs baseline on identical traces.
- Profiling log attached (profiling-20281007.log).

Short-term mitigations I propose:
- Flip the kernel selector to fallback for chat-large-1.2q for the next 48h while we tune scheduling (low-risk change).
- Reduce continuous batching window from 12ms to 8ms for affected routes (should reduce tail latency at minor throughput cost).

Can act as owner; aim to post a canary change by EOD 10/08 if we agree. Need Laura's confirmation on cost impact for the throughput change, and Soojin to sign off rollback steps.

-Markus
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia@novaapps.com>
Date: 2028-10-08T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Monthly KPI orbit: readiness check & action lanecard

Appreciate the debug. Cost notes from my side after a quick pass on billing + infra signals:

- The burst capacity on Dedicated accounts (auto-burst) added ~18% to infra spend last billing period because we hit sustained 6‑hour peaks during NovaApps demo windows.
- Changing continuous batching to 8ms as Markus suggests will likely raise unit GPU cycles by ~3-6% under p95 but should reduce customer-facing tail latency. Net cost delta TBD — I ran a conservative estimate and attached cost_breakdown_q3.xlsx.

I recommend two immediate actions:
A) Temporarily cap auto-burst to 20% of reserved capacity for NovaApps and other pilot customers until EOM.
B) Enable the quantization profile pilot for chat-large-1.2q on non-production (we can A/B for 10% of traffic). Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bRKPI-MonthlyPlaybook

I can join the Tue 10/09 10:00 PT sync. If leadership prefers, we can escalate to a 15-minute prep with the execs before the sync.

—Laura
VP, Financial Planning & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@novaapps.com>, Acme Analytics <ops@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-10-09T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Monthly KPI orbit: readiness check & action lanecard

Good alignment — summary and commitments for the QBR-ready action lanecard: 

1) Latency (owner: Markus) — kernel selector fallback for chat-large-1.2q to be rolled to canary 10/09 18:00 PT, monitor p95/p99 for 6h, rollback plan ready.
2) Cost (owner: Laura) — cap auto-burst at 20% for pilot accounts effective immediately; finance to report incremental delta in next invoice cycle.
3) Rollout/playbook (owner: Soojin) — enable quantization pilot on 10/10 for 10% traffic, watch quality regressions against baseline prompts. Runbook attached: runbook-quantization.md.
4) Communications — Olivia and Acme Analytics looped for visibility; we'll send a post-mortem note if the control-plane blip traces to infra change.

Deliverables before Tue 10/16 QBR prep: updated KPI dashboard (post-mitigations), cost delta snapshot, and a short playbook run log. I've attached profiling-20281007.log and the current dashboard PNG for the QBR pack.

Thanks everyone — meeting stands Tue 10/09 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Priyom
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
